name: Bollinger Bands RSI
summary: This EA combines Bollinger Bands with RSI to identify mean reversion trading opportunities. It enters long positions when price touches the lower Bollinger Band and RSI confirms oversold conditions, and enters short positions when price touches the upper Bollinger Band and RSI confirms overbought conditions. Exits are triggered when price reverts to the Bollinger Bands middle line or by fixed stop loss and take profit levels.
summary_zh: 该EA结合布林带和RSI指标识别均值回归交易机会。当价格触及布林带下轨且RSI确认超卖时做多，当价格触及布林带上轨且RSI确认超买时做空。价格回归布林带中轨或触及固定止损止盈时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用布林带与RSI双重确认的均值回归策略。入场条件为：做多时要求价格触及或跌破布林带下轨，同时RSI低于超卖阈值（通常为30），确认市场过度抛售；做空时要求价格触及或突破布林带上轨，同时RSI高于超买阈值（通常为70），确认市场过度买入。出场条件包括：价格回归布林带中轨时平仓获利，或触及固定止损/止盈水平。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算。资金管理方面，EA依赖止损订单控制单笔风险，但缺乏动态仓位调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，适合震荡行情，但在强趋势市场中可能遭受连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a mean reversion strategy with dual confirmation from Bollinger Bands and RSI indicators. Entry conditions require price to touch or breach the lower Bollinger Band combined with RSI below the oversold threshold (typically 30) for long positions, confirming excessive selling; for short positions, price must touch or exceed the upper Bollinger Band with RSI above the overbought threshold (typically 70), confirming excessive buying. Exit conditions include closing positions when price reverts to the Bollinger Band middle line for profit, or hitting fixed stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing typically uses fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations relative to account balance. Money management relies on stop loss orders to control per-trade risk but lacks dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear and suitable for ranging markets, but may suffer consecutive losses in strong trending conditions.
pros: 双指标确认过滤假信号，提高入场质量
均值回归策略逻辑清晰，易于理解和优化
布林带自适应波动率，在不同市场波动环境下自动调整入场阈值
适合震荡市场，能在价格过度偏离时捕捉回归利润
参数可调性强，便于针对不同品种和时间框架优化
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation filters false signals and improves entry quality
Mean reversion strategy logic is clear and easy to understand and optimize
Bollinger Bands adapt to volatility, automatically adjusting entry thresholds across different market volatility environments
Suitable for ranging markets, capturing mean reversion profits when price deviates excessively
Highly adjustable parameters facilitate optimization for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 均值回归策略在强趋势市场中会频繁逆势交易导致连续亏损
缺乏趋势过滤器，无法区分震荡市和趋势市
固定止损止盈可能不适合所有市场条件，缺乏动态风险管理
RSI与布林带信号可能产生滞后，导致入场时机不佳
缺乏仓位管理机制，无法根据市场波动率动态调整仓位
cons_en: Mean reversion strategy frequently trades against strong trends causing consecutive losses
Lacks trend filter to distinguish between ranging and trending markets
Fixed stop loss and take profit may not suit all market conditions, lacking dynamic risk management
RSI and Bollinger Band signals can lag, resulting in suboptimal entry timing
Lacks position sizing mechanism unable to dynamically adjust based on market volatility
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器（如ADX或更高周期均线），在趋势行情中暂停交易或反转策略
引入动态止损机制（如追踪止损或基于ATR的止损），替代固定点数止损
增加波动率自适应的仓位管理，根据ATR调整每笔交易的风险敞口
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., ADX or higher timeframe moving average) to pause trading or reverse strategy during trending markets
Introduce dynamic stop loss mechanism (e.g., trailing stop or ATR-based stop) to replace fixed pip-based stops
Implement volatility-adaptive position sizing that adjusts risk exposure per trade based on ATR

risk_points: 缺乏趋势过滤器，在单边行情中可能连续逆势建仓导致大幅回撤
固定手数交易缺乏资金管理，小账户可能因单笔亏损过大而爆仓
止损设为0时无风险保护，可能导致单笔交易亏损无限扩大
risk_points_en: Lacks trend filter, may consecutively build positions against trends causing significant drawdowns
Fixed lot sizing without proper money management may cause small accounts to blow up on single large losses
Stop loss set to 0 provides no risk protection, potentially leading to unlimited single-trade losses
